title: Layer 5 bursts are broadcast through the nonspecific thalamus

statements.text: Nonspecific thalamic nuclei project diffusely across the cortex, so a burst in a few cortical columns could reach the whole thalamo-cortical system. The nonspecific thalamus is the basis of a thalamo-cortical broadcasting system with layer 5 pyramidal neurons as its central elements.

sources.quote: the NSP thalamus is the basis for a thalamo-cortical broadcasting system and L5p cells are the central elements of it
